found: Exposed pale aggregate in a dark binder with one black crack running down the lower left. Broad dark diagonal bands sweep across the whole tile. Those bands are a large scale gradient rather than road wear, and they are what the 122471 ppm low frequency share is measuring; tiled, they would read as a repeating diagonal, so the texture lane should see this before it takes a1 for asphalt. No lettering, numeral, road marking, arrow, logo or watermark, and no kerb, manhole or gully.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
